function patchMediaExpanded(): void;

Defined in: core/safari/patches/media-expanded.ts:25

Installs the MediaExpanded patch once the element registers: wraps onMounted to (a) bind click + touchend on every close target — iOS click synthesis on fixed overlays is unreliable, so touchend with preventDefault drives the close directly — (b) assign the full-res src straight onto the expanded img (no lazy ladder inside the modal), and (c) force expanded videos muted/playsinline + play() so autoplay survives Safari's gesture policy.

Returns

void
